title: 16955 - 16955/P0571/001393
models: Tüm VAG Grubu Modeller (Audi, VW, Seat, Skoda, Porsche)
engines: Tüm VAG Benzinli (TSI/TFSI) ve Dizel (TDI) Motorlar
commonCauses: Kablo Tesisatı ve Soketleri and/or Connectors faulty
Wrong Brake Light Bulb installed (21W instead of 5/21W)
stepByStepSolution: Kontrol edin:  Kablo Tesisatı ve Soketleri or Connectors
Kontrol edin: /Değiştirin / Yenileyin:  Sigorta ve Röle Bağlantıları(s)
Kontrol edin: /Değiştirin / Yenileyin:  Brake Light Bulb(s)
technicalNotes:
Brake Light Switches (F) have the reputation of breaking quite often.
When found in the NAR market 2011+ (16/AJ) Jetta Sedan using PR code AW0 Version Low in addition to a BCM25/PQ25 BCM check the wiring to/from the brake light switch.  Internal Ref: ST?ID=66540
